summaryZh: 面向企业的 AI 数字员工与数字工厂桌面端，支持本地文件、Office 文档、企业知识库、模型配置和批量产物处理。
summaryEn: Desktop client for enterprise digital workers and digital factories, with local files, Office documents, knowledge bases, model configuration, and batch artifact workflows.
notesZh: 安装后请先绑定企业账号，再配置模型供应商。
若下载不可用，请确认 GitHub Release 的 tag 和安装包文件名已经发布。
notesEn: Bind your enterprise account and configure model providers after installation.
If the download is unavailable, verify the GitHub Release tag and installer asset name.
